serverInfo.name: candc-webmcp
serverInfo.title: C&C WebMCP
serverInfo.description: Browser-exposed WebMCP tools for checking availability, quoting stays, and starting the direct-booking checkout for the C&C parking space and eco studio near Fribourg, Switzerland.

transports.description: Parking reservation funnel: check_parking_availability, quote_parking_stay, start_parking_reservation_checkout. Requires a compatible browser agent with WebMCP support.
Eco studio reservation funnel: check_studio_availability, quote_studio_stay, start_studio_reservation_checkout. Requires a compatible browser agent with WebMCP support.
